2607.00588.title: Low Perplexity is Repetition: A One-Dimensional Self-Conditioning Attractor in Continuous Diffusion LMs
2607.00588.paper_summary: Continuous diffusion language models such as ELF report record-low generative perplexity (Gen-PPL). We find a catch: these models repeat far more than human text, and Gen-PPL rewards rather than penalizes that repetition, so its low scores overstate quality. Strip the repetition and ELF-B's Gen-PPL rises from $19.5$ to $27.7$; the smallest model even posts the best Gen-PPL because it repeats most. We trace the repetition to its source: a contractive attractor along a \emph{single direction} in the self-conditioning feedback loop, the loop that feeds each step's clean estimate into the next. Because the failure is one-dimensional, a one-dimensional fix suffices, and we propose one. \textbf{ACE} (Attractor-Contrast-Escape) subtracts that single, label-free direction from the feedback at each step. Estimated once on the $105$M model, the direction cuts repetition to near the human level while keeping quality competitive, and transfers near-unchanged to the $342$M and $652$M models and across samplers; the same recipe recovers useful directions on other architectures. Since Gen-PPL itself rewards repetition, we instead measure the compute each fix needs to produce human-clean text, where ACE is $1.5$--$5\times$ cheaper.
2607.00588.paper_summary_zh: 連續擴散語言模型如 ELF 報告了創紀錄的生成困惑度（Gen-PPL）。我們發現了一個問題：這些模型的重複率遠高於人類文本，而 Gen-PPL 獎勵而非懲罰這種重複，因此其低分數誇大了質量。去除重複後，ELF-B 的 Gen-PPL 從 $19.5$ 上升至 $27.7$；最小的模型甚至因為重複最多而獲得最佳的 Gen-PPL。我們追溯重複的來源：在自我條件反饋迴路中沿著 \emph{單一方向} 的收縮吸引子，這個迴路將每一步的乾淨估計輸入到下一步。由於失敗是單維的，因此一維的修正就足夠了，我們提出了一個修正方案。 \textbf{ACE}（吸引子-對比-逃逸）在每一步中從反饋中減去那個單一的、無標籤的方向。在 $105$M 模型上估算一次後，這個方向將重複率降低至接近人類水平，同時保持質量具有競爭力，並且幾乎不變地轉移到 $342$M 和 $652$M 模型及各種採樣器；相同的配方在其他架構上恢復有用的方向。由於 Gen-PPL 本身獎勵重複，我們改為測量每個修正需要的計算量，以生成人類乾淨的文本，其中 ACE 僅需 $1.5$--$5\times$ 的成本。
